concerns.text: FR-004 requires evaluating the distilled model against the **full MobileForge visual policy baseline** (see FR-004 and US-3), but FR-008 (and Constitution Principle VI) mandate that *all* training and evaluation must run on CPU only, with any CUDA usage causing failure. The full MobileForge visual policy is a GPU‑heavy model, making it impossible to satisfy both constraints simultaneously. This direct conflict makes the specification internally inconsistent.
